list.name: network
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT network FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT network FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest comparable result per method, criterion and operating point
panels.description: Compare rows only within the same criterion_framework and load_scale. Stochastic rows are the alpha quantile of the critical penetration with a distribution-free CI.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (method, criterion_framework, load_scale, hc_alpha, series_source, series_block_average_min, phase_model, existing_pv) method, criterion_framework, load_scale, hc_alpha, series_source, series_block_average_min AS block_min, phase_model, existing_pv, round(lambda_max::numeric, 3) AS lambda_max, round(total_pv_mw_comparable::numeric, 3) AS total_pv_mw, binding_constraint, round(hc_lambda_ci_low::numeric, 3) AS ci_low, round(hc_lambda_ci_high::numeric, 3) AS ci_high, run_label, run_timestamp FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity WHERE network = '$network' AND is_comparable ORDER BY method, criterion_framework, load_scale, hc_alpha, series_source, series_block_average_min, phase_model, existing_pv, run_timestamp DESC

panels.title: Hosting capacity by method and criterion (MW)

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (method, criterion_framework) method || ' / ' || criterion_framework AS label, total_pv_mw_comparable AS mw FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity WHERE network = '$network' AND is_comparable ORDER BY method, criterion_framework, run_timestamp DESC

SELECT method, criterion_framework, split_part(binding_constraint, '@', 1) AS constraint_type, count(*) AS runs FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity WHERE network = '$network' AND is_comparable AND binding_constraint IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 2, 4 DESC

panels.title: Runs that are not comparable (and why)
panels.description: baseline_infeasible = the network already violates the band without PV; legacy payloads and stochastic rows without a CI are also excluded from comparison.

targets.rawSql: SELECT method, status, criterion_framework, is_bounded, is_resolved, left(coalesce(error, ''), 140) AS error, run_timestamp FROM public_gold.mart_hosting_capacity WHERE network = '$network' AND NOT is_comparable ORDER BY run_timestamp DESC LIMIT 20
